title: Untitled (Mirror)
edition: Catalysed-ink three-colour silkscreen on mirrored polished steel. Edition of 120, plus 10 artist's proofs. Numbered, with printed artist stamp.

description.main: Untitled (Mirror) is a 2024 edition by Barbara Kruger, a three-colour silkscreen on mirrored polished steel published by Serpentine, London, for her exhibition Thinking of You. I Mean Me. I Mean You.
description.extended:
Untitled (Mirror) is a 2024 edition by Barbara Kruger, a three-colour silkscreen on mirrored polished steel published by Serpentine, London.

The panel measures 600 by 500 mm. A red border frames the mirror surface, and three lines of red capitals run down it: THINKING OF YOU, I MEAN ME, I MEAN YOU. Each YOU is struck through with a black line, and the viewer's reflection fills the space between the words. The work is printed in catalysed ink in an edition of 120 plus 10 artist's proofs, numbered, with a printed artist stamp.

Serpentine released the edition for Barbara Kruger: Thinking of You. I Mean Me. I Mean You., shown at Serpentine South from 1 February to 17 March 2024. The text on the mirror plays on the exhibition's title and offers a further variation on it.
description.artist_bio: Barbara Kruger (b. 1945, Newark, New Jersey) works with images and words, borrowing from the languages of advertising, graphic design and magazines. Her practice addresses power, gender, class and capital, often through direct address to the viewer. Her work has been shown in galleries and museums and installed on buildings, billboards, buses and skate parks.
description.exhibition_context: Barbara Kruger: Thinking of You. I Mean Me. I Mean You. was shown at Serpentine South, London, from 1 February to 17 March 2024, with Silent Writings presented in the public realm with Outernet Arts.
